spec.definitions: def exactCheck (q b : ℚ) : Bool := decide (|q| ≤ b)
spec.conclusion: ∀ q b : ℚ, exactCheck q b = true ↔ |q| ≤ b
spec.proof:
by
  intro q b
  simp only [exactCheck, decide_eq_true_eq]
